name: splitsmart
description: Group expense sharing with debt simplification (MERN + TypeScript)

scripts.setup: npm ci && npm ci --prefix server && npm ci --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n db,api,web -c blue,green,magenta "npm run db --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix server && npm run lint --prefix client
